**Coaching Note (80 words):**
Black's queen moved to f6 to defend, but this left two weaknesses: the undefended d5 knight and f7 pawn. After Nxf7+, Black's forced to recapture. Then Ne6+ creates a discovered attack on the loose d5 knight while checking the king. When Black takes your knight with the queen, you simply capture the now-loose d5 knight with your rook, netting a whole piece. Always scan for loose enemy pieces and look for forcing checks that exploit them.
